name: Optimizing Fut terminal render pipeline without benchmark overfitting

description: Baseline broad render-pipeline score across feed, encode, decode, and clone workloads

asi.hypothesis: Establish a stable multi-workload baseline before changing production code
asi.benchmark_design: Eleven representative operations across plain, styled, TUI, and dense workloads; benchmark harness and metric are now frozen
asi.constraints: No cadence reductions, workload changes, fixture-specific paths, or semantic shortcuts

description: Inline cell strings with compact_str did not compile because Ghostty writes into String

asi.hypothesis: Store short cell graphemes inline to remove per-cell heap allocation from snapshot, clone, and decode paths
asi.error: libghostty_vt::CellIteration::graphemes_utf8 requires &mut String, not a generic writer or CompactString
asi.next_action_hint: Retry with Ghostty writing to a reusable String scratch buffer, then convert/move into CompactString; conversion preserves inline storage for normal graphemes

description: Inline short cell graphemes improved aggregate 17% but one test fixture did not compile

asi.hypothesis: Compact inline cell contents plus a reusable Ghostty extraction buffer removes thousands of heap allocations from every snapshot and clone
asi.result: Aggregate improved 16.96%; feed improved 18.2%, wire improved 14.9%, with especially large clone gains
asi.error: A domain test directly assigned format!(...) String to Cell.contents and needs .into()
asi.rollback_reason: Correctness checks must compile and pass
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply the production change and convert the remaining test fixture String into CompactString, then rerun

description: Store short cell graphemes inline and reuse Ghostty extraction buffer

asi.hypothesis: Inline CompactString cell contents eliminate per-cell heap work across capture, clone, encode, and decode while preserving the string wire format
asi.result: Aggregate improved 14.23%; feed improved 14.55% and wire improved 13.70%; all correctness checks passed
asi.production_rationale: Terminal cells are bounded to 32 bytes and overwhelmingly one short grapheme, matching inline-string storage; long valid clusters still use CompactString heap fallback
asi.anti_overfit: Change applies to every screen cell and all workload shapes with unchanged serialized semantics

description: Skip wide-cell selection work when the terminal has no selection

asi.hypothesis: Normal render snapshots have no active Ghostty selection, so querying and storing every cell's width solely for selection normalization is wasted work
asi.result: Aggregate improved 4.17% from the previous best; feed improved 5.73%; wire was effectively unchanged within noise; all checks passed
asi.correctness: When a selection exists the original row ranges, per-cell widths, and wide-selection normalization run unchanged; existing wide/copy-mode tests pass
asi.anti_overfit: Optimization keys off real emulator selection state and benefits all ordinary terminal workloads

description: Compact variable cell wire encoding improved score 11.7% but rustfmt check failed

asi.hypothesis: Encode plain cells as strings and styled cells as compact tuples instead of repeating map field names for every cell
asi.result: Aggregate improved 11.68% from prior best; wire improved 29.65%; feed unchanged; benchmark passed
asi.error: Only cargo fmt --check failed on the visit_seq signature layout; compile and benchmark succeeded
asi.rollback_reason: All checks including formatting are required
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply identical Cell serde and protocol v12 change with rustfmt's one-line visit_seq signature

description: Compact cell wire retry exposed one dead helper under clippy

asi.hypothesis: Variable string-or-tuple cell encoding removes repeated per-cell map metadata and decoder branches
asi.result: Aggregate improved 13.24% from prior best in this run; wire improved 28.89%; benchmark passed
asi.error: Clippy -D warnings found is_false dead after removing derived Cell serde
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply the exact change and delete the now-unused is_false helper

description: Compact cell wire encoding requires updating two intentional wire-format pins

asi.hypothesis: Use a protocol-v12 variable cell encoding optimized for common plain and styled states
asi.result: Aggregate improved 13.49% from prior best; wire improved 29.84%; 334/336 tests passed
asi.error: Two tests intentionally pin old JSON/map MessagePack cell representations and now correctly observe tuple output
asi.rollback_reason: Tests must be updated atomically with intentional protocol format change
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply, change JSON expectation to ["λ",[16777217,50000102,15],true], and MessagePack bytes to [0x92,0xa1,b'o',0x93,0xce,0x02,0x0a,0x14,0x1e,0x00,0x01]

description: Compact cell wire encoding passed unit tests but hit unrelated copy-mode E2E flake

asi.hypothesis: Protocol-v12 string-or-tuple cells broadly reduce wire size and serde work
asi.result: Aggregate improved 12.55% from prior best; all 336 unit tests and 85/86 E2E tests passed
asi.error: keyboard_copy_search_uses_client_pbcopy_and_surfaces_success_and_failure timed out waiting for transient notice; this test passed before and failure is unrelated to cell roundtrip (all protocol/unit tests passed)
asi.rollback_reason: Automated checks require the full E2E suite to pass despite likely flake
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply unchanged and rerun; investigate only if the same E2E failure repeats

description: Compact cell wire encoding repeatedly breaks copy-search E2E notice behavior

asi.hypothesis: Protocol-v12 variable cell encoding should preserve all cell and selection semantics while reducing serde work
asi.result: Benchmark improved 13.30% from prior best and all unit tests passed, but the same copy-mode E2E failed twice
asi.error: keyboard_copy_search_uses_client_pbcopy_and_surfaces_success_and_failure never observed 'copy mode cancelled' after the format change
asi.rollback_reason: Repeated identical E2E failure indicates a likely real behavioral interaction, not safe to keep
asi.next_action_hint: Inspect the E2E sequence and client copy-mode delta/full-frame handling before retrying; verify selected-cell MessagePack frames and cancellation redraw independently

description: Faster cell wire exposed a deeper copy-mode burst sequencing race

asi.hypothesis: Adjust the E2E observer for correctly coalesced identical cancellation draws while retaining the compact cell wire win
asi.result: Cancellation burst loop advanced, but the subsequent clipboard capture condition timed out; all unit tests and 85/86 E2E tests passed
asi.error: With faster frame processing, keyboard_copy_search burst no longer always reaches pbcopy capture, indicating a real timing-sensitive client copy-action queue race beyond the stale notice assertion
asi.rollback_reason: Must fix root sequencing race before keeping wire optimization
asi.next_action_hint: Inspect CopyModeState request/action pump and response handling; faster replies may re-enter/pump queued actions incorrectly. Add a focused unit test independent of PTY timing, then retry compact wire

description: Encode cells as compact strings or tuples and harden copy-mode burst test

asi.hypothesis: A protocol-v12 cell representation specialized for plain and styled cells removes repeated map metadata and serde overhead across all frames
asi.result: Aggregate improved 12.89% from prior best; wire improved 29.35%; feed improved 2.17% within host variance; all 336 unit and 86 E2E tests passed
asi.correctness: Cell JSON/MessagePack shapes are explicitly pinned, protocol version bumped, selected/style roundtrips pass, and copy-mode burst coverage remains while making its retained-screen observation timing-independent
asi.anti_overfit: Plain cells become raw strings and styled cells tuples in the real local protocol; no benchmark-only branches or workload reductions

description: Use Ghostty dirty rows to patch a retained canonical snapshot, but clippy rejected explicit non-Drop lifetime release

asi.hypothesis: Retain the canonical terminal snapshot and extract only Ghostty Dirty::Partial rows while preserving complete published snapshots
asi.rollback_reason: Automated clippy rejects drop(snapshot) because Snapshot does not implement Drop
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply using a scoped render snapshot to end its borrow naturally before the full-rebuild fallback, then rerun unchanged

description: Ghostty dirty-row retained snapshots passed all checks but regressed the aggregate 1.8%

asi.hypothesis: Patch a retained canonical ScreenSnapshot from Ghostty Dirty::Partial rows instead of extracting every row after each feed
asi.rollback_reason: The extra full-grid CompactString clone required to retain and return owned ScreenSnapshots outweighed skipped FFI extraction in the benchmark workload, leaving render_ns 1.8% above run 12
asi.next_action_hint: Take the larger API swing: publish full-or-dirty-row terminal updates and mutate the runtime watch snapshot in place, eliminating the retained full-grid clone rather than layering retention inside GhosttyTerminal

description: Flatten styled cell tuples to remove one nested container per cell

asi.hypothesis: Encode styled cells as flat [contents, fg, bg, flags] tuples so MessagePack avoids a nested style array and nested serde visitor for every styled cell
asi.wire_format: Protocol v13; plain cells remain strings and selected styled cells append true
asi.observed: Aggregate improved 8.6% versus run 12, driven by substantially lower wire decode/materialization work

description: Pack both cell colors and flags into one u64, but the JSON wire pin had a miscalculated expected integer

asi.hypothesis: Pack CellStyle's two 26-bit colors and four flags into one u64 to reduce each styled cell to [contents, packed_style]
asi.rollback_reason: All semantics round-tripped but the intentional JSON shape pin expected the wrong decimal representation
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply unchanged with expected JSON integer 70909444472438785, then rerun
asi.observed: Valid benchmark improved render_ns another 5.1% over run 15 and reduced wire_ns roughly 20.5%

description: Pack cell colors and flags into one u64 style word

asi.hypothesis: Pack CellStyle's two 26-bit colors and four flags into one u64 so each styled cell decodes from [contents, packed_style]
asi.wire_format: Protocol v14; packed style uses 26 bits per color plus four modifier bits
asi.observed: Aggregate improved 4.6% versus run 15 and wire work fell another 20.8%

description: Extract single-codepoint cells without constructing a Ghostty grapheme buffer

asi.hypothesis: Use Ghostty's raw codepoint for ordinary cells and reserve graphemes_utf8 for actual multi-codepoint clusters
asi.observed: Aggregate improved 1.5%; this removes String buffer mutation and the heavier grapheme FFI path for the overwhelmingly common single-codepoint and blank cells
asi.correctness: Background-only cells remain blanks and CodepointGrapheme retains the existing exact extraction path

description: Build Fut's default cell style directly for unstyled Ghostty cells

asi.hypothesis: Avoid Style::default for every unstyled cell because Ghostty's Default implementation crosses FFI to initialize a much larger style
asi.observed: Aggregate improved 2.3%, with feed_ns down 3.2%; background-only cells still apply their raw background override to Fut's direct default
asi.scope: Common plain and blank cells avoid both full style lookup and Ghostty default style materialization

description: Store CellStyle packed in memory, but rustfmt check rejected three layout differences

asi.hypothesis: Keep CellStyle as the same packed u64 in memory and on wire to eliminate per-cell pack/unpack and shrink Cell equality/clone traffic
asi.rollback_reason: Implementation compiled and benchmarked but rustfmt check failed
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply the same newtype refactor and run rustfmt before the benchmark
asi.observed: Benchmark improved 0.7% overall and reduced wire_ns 5.6%; feed noise offset some of the wire win

description: Packed in-memory CellStyle retry missed seven test-only field accesses

asi.hypothesis: Keep CellStyle as a packed-u64 newtype so in-memory clone/equality and wire encode/decode use the same representation
asi.rollback_reason: Library and benchmark compiled, but test-only assertions still accessed removed public fields
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply and convert ghostty style assertions at lines 1755-1769 to accessor methods; rerun once to resolve the mixed aggregate signal
asi.observed: wire_ns remained about 4.9% better, while feed noise made aggregate 0.2% worse than run 19
